svg.aria-label: Every Gran Turismo session as one dot over the kit history; compile-storm crashes fade as the shader vault saturates and the GPU hang is pushed later by the GTK Turnip driver
svg.text: The GTK Turnip driver extends Gran Turismo playtime on ROCKNIX
Every Gran Turismo session on the SM8250 rig is one dot; height = how long it ran before it crashed or banked clean. 652 GT sessions, 23 days.
The kit is not a single trick — it is a shader vault ① and a custom Turnip driver ② attacking two different crash classes.
② GTK driver era — DRIVER tab · sddepth / syncdraw dials
① Shader vault (the kit): compile-storm crashes fade as the cache saturates — Silent share 19% → 14% of sessions.
② GTK Turnip driver (the fork): the GPU hang is not cured — crashes are reduced (73% → 50% of sessions), not prevented; the dials push the hang far later.
